title: Glowing mushroom
svg:
<svg viewBox='0 0 100 100' xmlns='http://www.w3.org/2000/svg'>
  <!-- glow aura -->
  <ellipse cx='50' cy='42' rx='38' ry='30' fill='#2a3a1a' opacity='0.55'/>
  <ellipse cx='50' cy='42' rx='30' ry='23' fill='#3a5a20' opacity='0.35'/>
  <!-- stem -->
  <path d='M42 58 Q40 72 38 84 Q38 88 42 88 L58 88 Q62 88 62 84 Q60 72 58 58 Z' fill='#e8dcc8'/>
  <path d='M46 62 Q45 74 44 84' stroke='#d4c8b0' stroke-width='2' fill='none'/>
  <path d='M54 62 Q55 74 56 84' stroke='#d4c8b0' stroke-width='2' fill='none'/>
  <!-- cap shadow underside -->
  <ellipse cx='50' cy='58' rx='30' ry='6' fill='#a83232'/>
  <!-- cap dome -->
  <path d='M18 56 Q18 26 50 22 Q82 26 82 56 Q82 60 50 60 Q18 60 18 56 Z' fill='#e83c3c'/>
  <!-- cap highlight -->
  <path d='M26 48 Q30 30 50 28 Q56 28 58 30 Q38 32 32 50 Q30 52 26 48 Z' fill='#ff6b6b'/>
  <!-- spots -->
  <circle cx='36' cy='38' r='6' fill='#fff0c8'/>
  <circle cx='58' cy='34' r='5' fill='#fff0c8'/>
  <circle cx='68' cy='46' r='4.5' fill='#fff0c8'/>
  <circle cx='46' cy='50' r='3.5' fill='#fff0c8'/>
  <circle cx='28' cy='52' r='3' fill='#fff0c8'/>
  <!-- glow dots around cap -->
  <circle cx='14' cy='38' r='2' fill='#aaff66' opacity='0.7'/>
  <circle cx='86' cy='40' r='2' fill='#aaff66' opacity='0.7'/>
  <circle cx='22' cy='24' r='1.8' fill='#aaff66' opacity='0.6'/>
  <circle cx='78' cy='22' r='1.8' fill='#aaff66' opacity='0.6'/>
  <circle cx='50' cy='16' r='2' fill='#aaff66' opacity='0.7'/>
  <circle cx='68' cy='20' r='1.5' fill='#aaff66' opacity='0.5'/>
  <circle cx='32' cy='18' r='1.5' fill='#aaff66' opacity='0.5'/>
  <!-- ground glow -->
  <ellipse cx='50' cy='90' rx='28' ry='4' fill='#3a5a20' opacity='0.6'/>
  <!-- tiny sparkles -->
  <path d='M12 56 l1.5 -3 l1.5 3 l-3 0z' fill='#aaff66' opacity='0.8'/>
  <path d='M87 54 l1.5 -3 l1.5 3 l-3 0z' fill='#aaff66' opacity='0.8'/>
</svg>
